title: Ballot source discovery
description: Web-search prompt that finds official sample-ballot or voter-lookup pages for the voter's jurisdiction and returns ranked sources as JSON.

variables.name: districts
variables.description: Districts that cover the voter (congressional, legislative, …).

variables.name: civicElections
variables.description: Upcoming elections from Google Civic, context only. At most 6 are included.

variables.name: savedContext
variables.description: Previously confirmed, non-sensitive ballot context (reuse scope, key, precinct, ballot style, party, verified source). Pass only when it is fresh or a low-confidence source.

surfaces: POST /api/ballot/source-discovery (Home → Election ballot research; Ballot Research wizard)

usage.notes: Sent to the OpenAI Responses API with web search. Blank lines between the jurisdiction, elections, and saved-context blocks are now consistent.
